scope: Effective 18 suites: 17 successes from the original complete run plus one actual conversion-inference rerun after a test-fixture-only repair. The rerun also passed the runner-required GPU suite, retained as additional evidence without duplicate counting. The original run failed; this is not a single all-passing 18-suite run and test inputs did not remain wholly unchanged. Production application and other snapshotted inputs retained identical hashes. Final DEB/install/corresponding-source acceptance is separate.
source_hash_scope: src/tests/scripts/assets/vendor/models, CMake/resources/launchers/runtime-info, root dependency locks and packaging Python/shell inputs; caches and four unrelated user files excluded. Documentation/evidence changes do not alter production input identity.

fixture_repair_transition.manual_review_boundary: Path/hash verification restricts the repair to one test fixture; it does not by itself prove semantic equivalence of edited assertions. The repository diff must be reviewed to retain all conversion/inference assertions.

superseded_original_failure.name: vision-conversion-inference-tests
superseded_original_failure.reason: Test fixture relied on removed automatic startup image; every retained failure occurred at starts.size()==0. Conversion/inference must be proven by the repaired rerun.

additional_verification.name: vision-gpu-tests
additional_verification.reason: The generic --with-gpu runner appends the GPU suite; effective GPU coverage uses the original successful run.

limitations: The repaired conversion suite and the runner-required GPU suite were rerun after the test-fixture edit. Effective totals use the original 17 successes plus only the repaired conversion suite; the duplicated GPU success is additional, not counted twice. The other successful suites retain unchanged test/source/binary identities.
The aggregation performs no builds, tests, inference, conversion or package acceptance.
Snapshot identity covers declared runtime metadata and dependency locks; external runtime trees are not independently rehashed by this tool.
Final corresponding source must include the corrected test fixture and be reverified separately.
No Windows 2.4.0 build or installation acceptance
Synthetic/derived labels validate evaluation mechanics, not general model accuracy
Local stop/timing observations are not performance guarantees
